headline: Singapore police arrested a man who made an AI image of a crocodile in a reservoir, which set off a two-day search.
score_reason: Old event (20 Aug 2026) now reaching charges; light story.
importance_line: It shows how one fake image can tie up emergency crews and bring criminal charges; the case is not yet decided and the man says he will plead guilty.
summary: Ukrainian tech site hi-Tech.ua reports that Singapore's national water agency searched Pandan Reservoir for two days from 20 Aug 2026 after a report of a crocodile, and closed water activities, before it was found that the picture was an AI-made hoax created with Google's Gemini. Police arrested a 30-year-old Myanmar national, who faces up to 10 years in prison on charges of spreading false information and obstructing justice, and a hearing is set for November.
notes: Site does not credit an earlier outlet.
